note: Audio folders that are also served from the two media repositories on GitHub Pages. The service worker (sw.js, through the generated media-hosts.js) asks the media host for a clip in one of these folders first and falls back to this site's own copy, so a site that carries every clip (Render) and a slim site that carries none both work. A clip must never come from a host that holds an older take, so 'trees' records, per sub-folder, the clips the hosts were last synced to, and media-hosts.js lists a sub-folder only while the clips here are exactly those. After changing a clip in one of these folders run node tools/deploy/media-hosts.mjs --write (tests/media-hosts.test.js fails until then): the changed sub-folder is served by this site again. To move it back to the host: node tools/deploy/media-hosts.mjs --sync <alef-packs clone> <alef-audio clone>, commit and push both clones, then commit this file and media-hosts.js. Set enabled to false to make every clip come from this site again.
